query:
UPDATE pricing_settings 
SET settingKey = 'fuel_consumption_rate', 
    settingValue = '8.00', 
    label = 'Vehicle Consumption (L/100km)', 
    description = 'Average fuel consumption rate in litres per 100km. Used to calculate distance-based fuel levy.',
    category = 'fuel',
    updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE id = 9;

INSERT INTO pricing_settings (settingKey, settingValue, label, description, category, isActive) VALUES
('fuel_price_per_litre', '2.50', 'Fuel Price ($/L)', 'Current fuel price per litre. Used with vehicle consumption to calculate distance-based fuel levy.', 'fuel', 1);
